slides.name: auth-wall
slides.html:
01 / 01THE AUTH WALL WHY AGENTS DIE QUIETLY
It is not the tools. It is the auth.
WHAT YOU DO
You wire up Gmail
connectors work, genuinely
You test it
it does the thing
You walk away
job done, you think
→
WHAT BREAKS
Seven days
later
the token expires
silent failure
Nothing tells you it stopped
→
WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENS
The agent stops
mid-run, no error surfaced
Monday's report never arrives
and you find out Wednesday
You blame the model
it was never the model
You rebuild it
and it dies again in a week
THE FIXa runtime that holds per-user OAuthauthorize onceadd your team, no tokens
@TYLERREEDAIGOOGLE REFRESHES EVERY 7 DAYS UNLESS YOU ARE A PRODUCTION APP

slides.name: skills-honest
slides.html:
01 / 01CLAUDE CODE SKILLS THE HONEST VERSION
It removes the typing. Not the judgment.
WHAT IT REMOVES
The pasted context
the same paragraph, every task
The same corrections
the ones you retype weekly
The format notes
how you want output shaped
→
WHAT IT IS
A markdown file
with instructions in it
that is all
No framework. No SDK.
→
WHAT IT NEVER DOES
Know the output is off
that is still you, every time
Pick the good draft
taste does not live in a file
Tell you the idea was weak
it will execute a bad one happily
Notice it went stale
tasks you only thought were repeatable
THE FILTERrepeatable and boring, hand it offhard, keep it
@TYLERREEDAIEIGHTY OR NINETY PERCENT, THEN YOU NUDGE IT THE REST OF THE WAY
